title: Balanced-Cell ATE Inference under Sparse Chart Review with Known Review Probability
banked_reason: D0.5.G delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field; projected paper-score ceiling 7.2 < 7.4, so field is capped at subfield.
gap_reasons: The contribution remains confined to a highly stylized equal-mass triangular array with known common Bernoulli review probability, and the attaining estimator is only an existence construction without numerical conditioning, computational complexity, or an empirical applicability demonstration.
The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved matched negative-log constants for minimax ATE risk and connected honest interval length over the balanced-cell model, including arbitrary known positive review sequences and finite-sample interval honesty. The field-tier novelty gate failed because the design remains stylized and the attaining estimator lacks a computational or empirical package. A broader unknown-mass design with matched converses is the suggested re-raise direction.
tldr: For any known positive chart-review sequence, the effective reviewed size \(S_N=Nq_N\) determines the consistency threshold and the divergent-regime exact negative-log rates for balanced-cell ATE inference: when \(S_N\to\infty\), minimax MSE and the expected length of a connected uniformly honest 90 percent interval have exact negative-log constants \(2b_\epsilon\) and \(b_\epsilon\) on the scale \(\log S_N/\log\log(eS_N)\); both criteria are consistent exactly in this regime and have positive lower limits when \(S_N\) is bounded. No monotonicity or \(q_N\to0\) condition is required. The model allows every binary-outcome mean in \([0,1]\). Review probabilities bounded below give the original fixed-positive formulas as uniform corollaries, while supplied propensities restore order \(N^{-1}\) risk.
gap: Published discrete-ATE lower bounds stop before the balanced point \(n=d\), while regular chart-review efficiency theory excludes unrestricted cellwise nuisance variation at occupancy one. Zeng et al. permit outcome means in \([0,1]\); the present theorem instead maintains the scientifically nondegenerate band \([\eta,1-\eta]\) and does not attribute that restriction to their model. The internal arbitrary-mass annotation theorem uses rare or null masses and cannot certify a lower bound on the known-uniform subclass.
fill: The project constructs an observable marked factorial estimator, proves an all-degree risk certificate and direct fixed-size balanced mixture converse within the maintained interior band, converts the same modulus into honest connected-interval length, and identifies the known-propensity oracle gap.
